newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID BACK IN CONTENTION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID BACK IN CONTENTION.

text.p: Atletico Madrid jumped from eighth to fifth in the Spanish first division on Monday after beating Valladolid 3-0.
The champions have 24 points from 14 games, two behind fourth-placed Real Betis and eight adrift of leaders Real Madrid.
Valladolid dominated the first half, only to see Atletico go ahead on the half-hour after a long-range shot from Juan Vizcaino caught a deflection.

Atletico turned up the pressure after the break and extended their lead through ex-Valladolid player Jose Luis Caminero -- who apologised to his former fans -- and home defender Jose Luis Santamaria, who turned a cross from Milinko Pantic into his own net.
